title: Meakin 2013: muscle volume of paraspinal / lumbar extensor mass at L3-L4_to_sacrum (F, supine)
muscle_as_reported: lumbar extensor muscles (iliocostalis, longissimus, multifidus; possibly rotatores, interspinales, intertransversarii); macroscopic fat excluded

imaging.modality: MRI T1 axial, 4 mm slices (9 mm effective spacing)
imaging.plane: axial slices approximately parallel to the L3/L4 disc, summed caudally
imaging.level_definition: volume caudal to the L3/L4 disc (L3/L4 to last caudal slice with extensor muscle)

source.authors: Meakin JR, Fulford J, Seymour R, Welsman JR, Knapp KM
source.sample: 42 women; female volunteers (5 with current back pain); age 50 (13) y, height 165 (7) cm, median mass 70 kg (IQR 18)

how_to_simulate: Pose the model supine with lower lumbar curvature (L4-S1 endplate angle) ~30 deg.
Integrate the anatomical CSA of all model posterior paraspinal elements from the L3/L4 disc plane caudally (volume).

subject_model.source: Results text (mass = median); hL4S1 lordosis 30 (7) deg

protocol.notes: Includes the 5 subjects with current back pain (whose volume was smaller). Correlations (Table 2) not stored.

data.note: side not stated (outline of "the lumbar extensor muscles"; Fig. 1)

extraction.check_notes: Values re-read from abstract and results.
